# Code paths, file names and identifiers with punctuation between letters, typed
# correctly in the English layout.
#
# Used by tests/dev_tokens.rs and examples/measure_token_false_positives.rs to
# count how often automatic conversion would rewrite such a token as the same
# physical keys read in another layout: the layout model turned "key.md" into
# the Russian "лунюьв" and read the colons of "Default::default" and
# "LANGID:KLID" as the Estonian "Ö" (goal D's follow-up, plan item K6). The
# test file explains how to re-baseline the budget.
#
# Format: one token per line, letters a-z and A-Z joined by "." or ":" or "::",
# two or more letters in every part, sorted (byte order) and unique. Lines that
# start with '#' are comments.
#
# Sources (public text only): every such token in this repository's tracked
# Rust sources and Markdown documents, found with
#   git ls-files '*.rs' '*.md' | xargs grep -ohE '[A-Za-z]+((::|[.:])[A-Za-z]+)+'
# and kept when every part has two or more letters. Two Russian words quoted
# there as typed in the wrong layout (cktle.ott, gthtrk.xtybt) were left out.
# Host names in it are those of public sites the documents link to.
#
# Snapshot taken on 2026-10-19 from the repository at commit 75d260d.
